summary:
Iteration 15 — Post-Launch Optimization (7 maintenance items, option b). BACKEND: 62/62 pytests pass (51 regression: test_final_launch 11 + test_phase1_real_providers 9 + test_phase6_publishing 13 + test_ai_ads_phase345 18; + NEW 11 in test_iter15_maintenance.py). FRONTEND: 4 of 7 items verified passing; 3 maintenance items FAILED live verification despite being claimed shipped:

✅ PASSING (4/7):
  (1) MongoDB indexes — backend log 'MongoDB indexes ensured on hot collections' confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log on every startup; hot endpoints (/api/ai-ads/health, /assets, /calendar, /publish-queue, /analytics) all respond well under 1500ms end-to-end through ingress.
  (2) Mobile sub-tab horizontal-scroll fix — at 390x844 viewport, [data-testid='ai-subtabs'] has scrollWidth(840+) > clientWidth(374), overflow-x: auto. All 14 sub-tab buttons present with whitespace-nowrap shrink-0. Container class includes 'md:flex-wrap md:overflow-x-visible' — wraps on desktop as expected.
  (3) Test All Connections — POST /api/ai-ads/provider-connections/test-all works perfectly: no-connections returns {results:[],summary:{connected:0,passed:0,failed:0}}; with 1 connected provider (email/SendGrid bogus key) returns 1 result with real upstream error, summary {connected:1,passed:0,failed:1}, and last_test_at/last_test_ok/last_test_message persisted on the connection doc. UI: [data-testid='providers-test-all'] button shows 'Test All Connections (1)' when connected; clicking renders [data-testid='providers-test-all-result'] banner '0/1 connections healthy · 1 failed (see card details below).' ✅
  (6) Plugin catalog pre-warm — GET /api/ai-ads/plugins/restaurant <1500ms; cache hit confirmed.

❌ FAILING (3/7):
  (4) 401 'Session expired' toast — DOES NOT APPEAR. Sonner Toaster element [data-sonner-toaster] is NOT present anywhere in the rendered DOM despite being mounted in /app/frontend/src/index.js line 38 inside <ErrorBoundary>. Setting localStorage admin_token='INVALID' then navigating to AI Ads → Library (which triggers /api/ai-ads/assets) does not produce any visible toast. Likely root cause: <Toaster /> component from @/components/ui/sonner depends on useTheme() from next-themes but no <ThemeProvider> wraps the tree — the component may be silently failing or the portal isn't mounting. Verified via document.querySelector('[data-sonner-toaster]') === null AND document.body.innerText does not contain 'Session expired'.
  (5) Library search debounce — BROKEN. Typing 5 rapid characters into [data-testid='ai-library-q'] fired 5+ /api/ai-ads/assets requests immediately (one per keystroke), then 1 more after the 350ms window for a total of 6. Root cause in /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/aiads/CreativeLibrary.jsx line 166: `const effectiveFilters = useMemo(() => ({ ...filters, q: debouncedQ }), [filters, debouncedQ]);` — because the entire `filters` object is in the dep array, every keystroke (which updates filters.q) creates a NEW filters reference, which creates a NEW effectiveFilters reference, which triggers the load() useEffect on line 168 immediately. debouncedQ is correctly delayed by 350ms, but it doesn't matter because the effect already re-fires on every filters object reference change. FIX: depend on individual scalar fields, e.g., `useMemo(() => ({ kind: filters.kind, platform: filters.platform, status: filters.status, is_favorite: filters.is_favorite, date_from: filters.date_from, date_to: filters.date_to, q: debouncedQ }), [filters.kind, filters.platform, filters.status, filters.is_favorite, filters.date_from, filters.date_to, debouncedQ])` so reference is stable when only q changes pre-debounce.
  (7) Recharts width(-1) warnings — NOT mitigated. On a fresh mount of AI Ads → Analytics sub-tab, 6 console warnings printed: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0, please check the style of container, or the props width(100%) and height(100%), or add a minWidth(0) or minHeight(undefined) to your chart.' The claimed mitigation via h-60 min-h-[240px] + mount-delay state is NOT working — chart containers report -1 width on first measurement. Frontend agent should investigate ResponsiveContainer parent dimensions and possibly add a key={mounted} prop or render charts only after a 1-frame requestAnimationFrame delay.

ui_bugs.issue: Debounce broken — 5 keystrokes fire 5+ /api/ai-ads/assets requests immediately (one per keystroke) instead of one after 350ms. effectiveFilters useMemo depends on whole `filters` object, so each filters.q update creates new reference and re-triggers the load useEffect immediately, defeating the debounce on debouncedQ. File: /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/aiads/CreativeLibrary.jsx line 166-177.

Global axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/index.js fires toast.error('Session expired') on 401, but Sonner Toaster element [data-sonner-toaster] is NOT in the DOM. document.querySelector('[data-sonner-toaster]') returns null. Possibly next-themes useTheme() failing silently because no ThemeProvider wraps App, or portal not mounting. End result: no visible toast on expired token; user gets silent failure.

6 'Recharts width(-1)/height(-1)' console warnings printed on a fresh Analytics sub-tab mount. Claimed mitigation (h-60 min-h-[240px] + mount-delay state) is not effective. Chart containers report -1 width on first measurement. Consider rendering chart only after a useState(false) flips to true via useEffect rAF callback, or ensure ResponsiveContainer has a guaranteed-non-zero parent.

action_items: FIX (5) Library search debounce: in /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/aiads/CreativeLibrary.jsx line 166, change useMemo deps from [filters, debouncedQ] to individual scalar fields ([filters.kind, filters.platform, filters.status, filters.is_favorite, filters.date_from, filters.date_to, debouncedQ]) so the effectiveFilters reference is stable when only filters.q changes (pre-debounce). This restores the intended single-fire-after-350ms behavior.

FIX (4) 401 'Session expired' toast: Sonner Toaster is mounted in /app/frontend/src/index.js but not appearing in DOM ([data-sonner-toaster] is null). Likely fix options: (a) wrap App with a <ThemeProvider> from next-themes so useTheme() doesn't bail; (b) replace shadcn Toaster wrapper with direct `<Sonner />` import from 'sonner' to bypass next-themes dependency; (c) check for runtime error in ErrorBoundary that may be silently swallowing the Toaster render.

FIX (7) Recharts width(-1) warnings: 6 warnings still appear on Analytics mount despite claimed mitigation. Recommendation — wrap each ResponsiveContainer in a div that gets a sentinel width via useLayoutEffect+requestAnimationFrame before rendering the chart, or use a useState(false) → useEffect(() => setMounted(true)) gate around chart components.

OPTIONAL (3) Polish: 'Test All' result banner currently shows '0/1 connections healthy · 1 failed' but doesn't list which provider failed inline. Consider adding the per-provider mini-summary directly under the banner.
critical_code_review_comments: CreativeLibrary debounce bug is a classic useMemo dep-array pitfall — the value is correctly memoized but a parent object dep churns. Always destructure to scalar deps when working around debounced + non-debounced fields living on the same object.

Test-All endpoint design (asyncio.gather across all conns + persisting last_test_at) is correctly implemented and verified live with a real bogus SendGrid key — returned 'SendGrid returned 401' from the upstream API, proving non-mocked.
MongoDB index creation in on_startup is idempotent (Motor's create_index recognizes existing names) — safe on cold start, ~5ms overhead.

ResponsiveContainer behavior with -1 width is a known Recharts complaint when the container's parent has not yet been laid out at first measurement. The current h-60 min-h-[240px] addresses HEIGHT but Recharts also measures WIDTH from offsetParent, which may be 0 during first paint of a hidden sub-tab. Mount-delay state alone isn't enough — needs an explicit width sentinel or requestAnimationFrame gate.

Sonner Toaster wrapper at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx pulls in next-themes useTheme() — if next-themes is missing a ThemeProvider, useTheme() returns `{theme: undefined}` which destructures fine via the default, but the package may also throw at import if not properly installed. Worth verifying `npm ls next-themes` in /app/frontend.

success_rate.frontend: 57% (4 of 7 maintenance items verified passing; items 4, 5, 7 fail live verification)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 15 found 3 real bugs in the claimed-shipped maintenance items: (4) Sonner Toaster not in DOM — [data-sonner-toaster] missing — so no 401 toast appears; (5) Library debounce broken because useMemo deps include the whole filters object causing per-keystroke ref churn; (7) Recharts width(-1) warnings still printed 6x on Analytics mount. Items (1), (2), (3), (6) are all verified working. Backend regression is 100% green (62/62). After main agent fixes the 3 frontend items, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_maintenance.py + a Playwright check on Library debounce (≤2 /assets calls for 5 keystrokes) + Analytics console (0 Recharts warnings) + clear admin_token → click sub-tab → verify [data-sonner-toaster] exists and contains 'Session expired'.
rca of the issue:
BUG (5) — Debounce: In /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/aiads/CreativeLibrary.jsx, debouncedQ is correctly updated via setTimeout 350ms, but `effectiveFilters` useMemo on line 166 declares `[filters, debouncedQ]` as deps. Every keystroke updates filters.q which mutates the filters reference → effectiveFilters becomes a new object → load useEffect (line 168, dep [load, effectiveFilters]) re-fires immediately, hitting the API per keystroke. The debounce on debouncedQ is functionally irrelevant for triggering loads.
BUG (4) — Toast: Sonner's <Toaster /> normally renders <ol data-sonner-toaster> via createPortal regardless of toast state. The absence of [data-sonner-toaster] in DOM indicates the component is not mounting — possibly because the shadcn wrapper /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx uses useTheme() from next-themes and may throw or render null in some path, or next-themes isn't installed. Confirm with `yarn list next-themes` in /app/frontend.
BUG (7) — Recharts: ResponsiveContainer measures parent width on first paint; if the parent has display:none ancestor briefly (sub-tab content gated by activeSubtab state mounts inline but sibling tabs may push layout), the initial measurement is -1. The current h-60 min-h-[240px] addresses container HEIGHT only, not the timing of width measurement. Fix needs either a 1-frame rAF gate or replacing -1 by reading offsetWidth post-mount.
